scope_limits: LLVM signatures and equal layout do not prove an FFI ABI.
The conservative Clang gate includes cases with no observed native failure until a compatible ABI carrier is proved.
Native ARM and macOS verification of the fixed wider/storage fixture must come from CI.
Archive ordering is fixed in the test; Linux ARM relinking remains a native CI gate.

primary_sources.relevance: Apple ARM requires the caller to extend narrow integer arguments.
Apple Intel also specifies narrow integer extension.
System V excess argument bits are unspecified; LLVM extension attributes still produced the observed optimized Rust mismatch.
repr(C) follows the C aggregate ABI, whereas repr(transparent) follows its field.
